prompt: A table of 50,000 log rows freezes the browser when it renders.
why: Render only the rows in view (plus a buffer).
trap: The cost is DOM nodes, not computation.

prompt: Scrolling a chat with 20,000 messages gets janky, and memory keeps growing.
trap: Debouncing scroll events doesn't remove DOM nodes.

prompt: A virtualized feed jumps around because posts have different heights that aren't known until they render.
why: Use dynamic measurement (estimate, then measure and cache) in the virtualizer.

prompt: A searchable dropdown with 30,000 cities lags when opening.
trap: Debouncing the search helps typing, not opening.

prompt: A web spreadsheet with 1,000 rows and 200 columns is unusable when scrolling.
why: Virtualize rows and columns; render only visible cells.

prompt: A photo library grid of 30,000 thumbnails crashes mobile Safari.
why: Virtualize the grid so only visible tiles exist.
trap: Smaller images help, but 30,000 elements still kill memory.

prompt: A live log viewer appends lines forever, and after an hour the tab uses 2 GB of memory.
trap: The leak is DOM nodes kept forever.

prompt: After virtualizing a long document, users complain the browser's Ctrl+F can't find text further down.
why: Unrendered rows aren't searchable; add in-app search or render more.
